title: Phase 1: online explorer (bot.explore)
description: src/explorer.rs + explore branches in src/driver.rs (chaos_bot_system, chaos_mouse_system). Screen = set of enabled widget names (signature ignores numerals; names keep digits / positional numbering / <role>#n). Least-tried key and widget per screen (ties broken by the recorded draw, replay-faithful). Novelty = new state schedule or new screen. Stuck 3 s -> Escape back-out (not on first screen with widgets; window doubles per back-out on that screen; timed from max(last_novelty, arrived)). 3 of 4 clicks go to the least-tried enabled widget, 1 of 4 random. ExplorationSummary on the report (screens_seen, states_entered, widgets_never_clicked, keys_never_pressed, back_outs, last_discovery_frame, verdict). ui-surface enabled by default under takeover; Interaction nodes count as widgets. BEVY_PLAYTEST_DISCOVER removed.

title: Explorer PR #112 (feat/explorer): merge
description:
PR #112 = explorer + new baseline + two fixes found by its own evaluation:
- 157fe76 thetawave re-pinned to fork commit fe66df3 (branch bevy-0.20-pause-sound): silent stand-in for sounds/menu_input_success.wav, which the pause menu loads by path. The explorer reached the pause menu for the first time and log_error caught the missing file (a fixture-port bug, upstream ships it).
- 719d19d ui-surface: Pickable::IGNORE nodes are not click targets (mines put it on revealed tiles; explorer wasted 3/4 clicks there; mines M2 fell 3/5 -> 0/5).
First full eval (44780237619, before the fixes): game_menu G1/G4 3/5@3115 -> 5/5@889, G2 4/5@1371 -> 5/5@459; thetawave T1 @1017 -> @63, T2 @2052 -> @192; mines M2 3/5 -> 0/5, M4 4/5 -> 1/5 (fixed by 719d19d: quick eval 2 seeds M2 1/2, M4 2/2). Full re-run 44782921489 on 719d19d.
acceptance_criteria: Full 5-seed eval on 719d19d compared target by target with eval/baseline; comparison table in the PR description; mines not worse than baseline (or the regression explained and ticketed); CI green; maintainer merges.
close_reason: Merged as #112 (9244810..8a46d55). Full eval run 44782921489: table in the PR description.

title: Bot exploration of Bevy games: reach menus, HUD, gameplay; find bugs; report honestly
description:
North star. The chaos/explore bot must pass menus, reach gameplay, use keyboard, mouse (clicks, drags, wheel), gamepad and text input, find bugs through the oracles, and report what it exercised and, honestly, what it did NOT (never-entered states, untried widgets/keys, input kinds not covered).

Ground rules (from the maintainer):
- Breaking changes are fine (sole user). Dev-only build flags are fine: released games never include bevy_playtest.
- Every PR needs explicit per-PR consent; PR descriptions never carry a 'Generated with Claude Code' footer. Commits may carry Co-Authored-By.
- 'Final review' (code-review skill) before merging; maintainer merges.
- Never run full test suites or evaluations locally (machine overloads even niced): use CI. Local runs: nice -n 19, cargo -j 4, nextest --test-threads 1, TMPDIR=~/.cache/claude-build-tmp (/tmp is tiny).
- Measure every exploration change with the evaluation (eval/targets, eval/baseline, .github/workflows/evaluate.yml): PRs touching exploration get a quick 2-seed run; full 5 seeds x 5000 frames via workflow_dispatch. Compare target by target against eval/baseline/*.json (hits/runs and median frame).

Phases: 0 measure (done), 1 online explorer (PR #112), 2 richer inputs and signals (branch feat/explorer-phase2), 3 replay archive, 4 coverage-guided exploration.

title: Seed sweep (#102): rebased onto main, reviewed; land it
description: PR #102 (feat/seed-sweep) was branched before #110-#112. Rebased onto main as feat/seed-sweep-rebased (78c10be + review fixes 29a38c2): conflicts resolved, tests moved to tests/it/sweep.rs, discovery leftovers dropped, deterministic-randomness seed now follows seed_override (test: seed 6 builds a different world than seed 5), thetawave pin e5354f8. Review fixes: panics never fingerprinted, '#'/newline invariant names rejected, note newlines refused, no healed advice with red members, gate prints known findings, repro command labelled approximate. Remaining: the PR still points at the old feat/seed-sweep (force-push blocked in the agent session) - either force-push feat/seed-sweep-rebased onto feat/seed-sweep or open a replacement PR.

title: Phase 2: run quick + full evaluation on feat/explorer-phase2, compare to #112 numbers
description: Prior keys, combos and drags change the draw sequence: re-measure every target. Watch mines (drags steal clicks from tiles), game_menu, thetawave. Use CI only (gh workflow run evaluate.yml --ref feat/explorer-phase2).
acceptance_criteria: No target worse than #112's full eval without an explanation; table in the PR description.
notes: PR #113 opened (37da93e). Full eval 44802374359: game_menu G1 @511, thetawave T1 @33 T2 @120, mines M1-M5 all 5/5 (M1 slower @1521: prior keys take the keyboard ticks).

title: Mouse drags (press, move while held, release on another widget)
description: Commit 9a20286. Every 4th mouse action (DRAG_EVERY) in explore mode: press on least-tried widget (kind 'drag') or random spot, move one step/frame for DRAG_FRAMES=12, release on another enabled widget 3 of 4 times (DragDrop can fire) else random. Destination = second MousePosition draw on the press frame. ui_surface now treats entity observers of PointerDragStart/Drag/DragEnd/DragDrop as interactable. Test: explorer_drags_one_widget_onto_another.
notes: Eval 44785825713 showed drags every 4th mouse action cost clicks (game_menu G1 889 -> 2641, mines M1 585 -> 1275). Fixed in 8e7c9e1: every 4th only when a node declares drag handling (InteractableKind::Draggable), else every 16th; drags start from draggable nodes.

title: Prior keys: try 27 common keys once per screen; report keys_found
description: Commit d00ba25. Prior = PROBE_CANDIDATE_KEYS minus Escape/Tab. A key followed within CREDIT_FRAMES=30 (0.5 s) by a new state or screen stays in rotation (productive). keys_never_pressed now lists declared keys only. Test: explorer_finds_an_undeclared_key_through_the_prior.

title: Modifier+key combos (Ctrl+S, Shift+L)
description: Commit fa777d5. Every 4th key press (COMBO_EVERY) holds Ctrl/Shift/Alt under a declared or productive key, least-tried combo per screen. Modifier down first and up last; one labelled Key draw ('ControlLeft+KeyS'); waits for both hold slots. combos_tried / combos_found in the summary. Test: explorer_finds_a_modifier_combo.

title: Phase 2: richer inputs and signals (branch feat/explorer-phase2)
description: Stacked on feat/explorer (#112). Pushed to origin as feat/explorer-phase2, no PR yet. Rebase onto main after #112 merges, then quick+full eval and PR (with consent). Every new input kind must be replay-faithful: decisions depend only on recorded draws or delivered inputs; extra draws happen on the same frame in a fixed order (ChoiceStream replays by frame, then order).
notes: feat/explorer-phase2 rebased onto main after #112 (f1d603d); full eval dispatched.

title: Thetawave fork: rebase bevy-0.20 (seed_override sync) onto bevy-0.20-pause-sound
description: Fork mcanevet/thetawave branch bevy-0.20 has 6895ffc 'Sync tests/playtest.rs' adding seed_override: None (BatteryConfig field not on main yet; it comes with the maintainer's seed-sweep work). #112 pins fe66df3 on branch bevy-0.20-pause-sound (= 314fca6 + the wav stand-in). When seed_override lands, the pin must contain BOTH: rebase 6895ffc onto fe66df3 (or cherry-pick the wav), re-pin THETAWAVE_REV in scripts/fetch_bevy_examples.sh, update docs/reference/thetawave-fixture.md branch name. Committed fixtures/thetawave/tests/playtest.rs must stay byte-identical to the fork copy.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned fork commit has both the wav and the seed_override test sync; fixtures job green.
notes: Done on branch feat/seed-sweep-rebased (#102 rebased onto main): fork commit e5354f8 (branch bevy-0.20-seed-sweep = fe66df3 pause-sound + 6895ffc seed_override test sync) pinned in scripts/fetch_bevy_examples.sh. Closes when #102 merges.
close_reason: Thetawave pinned to fork e5354f8 (branch bevy-0.20-seed-sweep) with #102.

title: Mines: live tiles invisible to the explorer (global observer, no marker)
description: fixtures/mines tiles are UI nodes with TileCell but no Pickable/Interaction/entity observer: clicks are handled by a GLOBAL On<PointerClick> observer that filters by event_target. ui_surface only attributes entity-scoped observers, so the tiles are not targets and only the random 1-in-4 clicks reach them. Options: (a) treat nodes under the pointer that receive picking hits as candidates (probe: hit-test sweep over a grid of points each recapture, keep nodes whose PointerClick bubbled to a global observer = observed in the trace); (b) heuristics: leaf UI nodes with BackgroundColor/BorderColor inside a Display::Grid; (c) report honestly: 'clickable regions without a marker are probed at random only'. Prefer (a) then (c).
acceptance_criteria: Mines M2 (reveal ~10 tiles) >= baseline 3/5 on the full eval; report states the remaining blind spot.
notes: Implemented on feat/explorer-phase2 (3395a99, 8e7c9e1): learned click targets. A random press reads HoverMap the next frame; if the game reacts within 10 frames (state schedule ran, or a game resource changed that did not change the frame before), the hovered node archetypes (component ids minus ChildOf/Children/PickingInteraction) get a credit; after 2, every node of that archetype is an InteractableKind::Learned target. Test: 25 undeclared cells, 25/25 revealed with learning vs 6/25 without. Awaiting full eval run 44788275013 for mines M2.
close_reason: Learned click targets in #113: mines M2/M4/M5 5/5.

title: Measure baseline after cursor fix + deterministic RNG
description: Full run 44776521936 on 85ed12e. Highlights: thetawave T1 5/5@1017, T2 5/5@2052; mines M2 3/5@3459, M4 4/5@2979; game_menu G1 3/5@3115; loading L1 @114.

title: Deterministic OS randomness per seed (LD_PRELOAD getrandom shim)
description: detrng/shim.rs (no_std cdylib built by build.rs, path in BEVY_PT_DETRNG_SHIM), seed env BEVY_PLAYTEST_DETRNG_SEED, opt-out BEVY_PLAYTEST_DETRNG_DISABLE. Main thread has its own stream (repeatable under the single-threaded executor). Not covered: getrandom 0.2 raw syscall, /dev/urandom, arc4random.

title: Cursor fix: bot sets Window cursor position so bevy_ui Interaction works
Runaway oracle: out of +-1000 AND moving away for 0.5 s
description: Default bounds oracle flags runaways, not far geometry (9eb7a12).

title: State trace recorder (OnEnter/OnExit + resource change ticks)
description: Records schedules run and resource changes per frame; names need bevy_ecs 'debug' feature (off by default in bevy).

title: Phase 0: measure exploration (targets + baseline)
description: Targets per fixture (eval/targets/*.json: id, description, measure on state trace / resource change counts) and a baseline measured with plain chaos (eval/baseline/*.json). Evaluator: bevy_playtest_eval (src/bin), library src/evaluation.rs. Workflow .github/workflows/evaluate.yml: PR quick run (2 seeds x 5000 frames, path-filtered), full run on workflow_dispatch (5 seeds x 5000). No schedule (deliberate: evaluation only matters when exploration code changes).

title: Draft exploration targets for every fixture
description: eval/targets/*.json for game_menu, thetawave, mines, breakout, loading_screen, desk_toy, contributors, known_answer, alien_cake_addict. Criteria include median-frame targets.

title: Thetawave battery golden pins an exploration-dependent stall
description: fixtures/thetawave/tests/playtest.rs pins a churning-but-dead stalled_progress finding on the battery seed. Whether that one seed stalls depends on where the explorer goes, so the golden flipped twice during #113 (37da93e stall, f69e3b7 no stall, 655c16f stall again). Options: pin it with a frame-window ExpectFinding plus a note that explorer changes may move it; run the golden with a scripted scenario that deterministically idles in the menu (the stall is the exhibit: menu idle animation churns with no verifiable state); or assert only the dithering warning plus 'no gating finding other than stalled_progress'. The scripted-idle option keeps the exhibit honest.

title: Confirm keys_found/combos_found by replay (rule out timed transitions)
description: With input turns (37da93e), keys and combos get credit when a new state or screen follows within one input tick and no click is near. game_menu still shows candidates (Digit6, Shift+ArrowUp, Ctrl+ArrowRight in 3/5 seeds) for a game that ignores the keyboard: timed transitions (splash timeout, the 5 s game round ending) coincide with a key press. No timing rule can tell them apart. With the phase 3 replay archive: replay the prefix up to the key without the key (and with it); credit only if the novelty appears with the key and not without. Until then the report labels them 'followed by, not proven'.

title: Thetawave: entities fall past y=-1260 still moving away (nodes_in_bounds, seed 2)
description: Phase 2 eval run 44788275013 (8e7c9e1), thetawave seed 2: nodes_in_bounds flagged 589v39 at (782.62, -1260.44, 20) and 644v37 at (598.54, -1260.44, 20), out of bounds and still moving away after 30 frames. First run that played thetawave long enough. Triage: which entity type (mob? projectile? consumable?), does upstream rely on a despawn zone it missed, or is the runaway oracle's +-1000 bound too tight for thetawave's arena (then make the bound scenario-configurable).

title: Cell archive + frontier selection across runs
description: Store cells and prefixes per seed in the battery; choose frontier cells by rarity / recency; spend the run budget across several replays. Report cells reached.
acceptance_criteria: Deep targets (mines M5 start three games, thetawave later levels) improve on the full eval.

title: Phase 3: replay archive (Go-Explore style)
description: Archive every novel cell (state set + screen signature) with the choice prefix that reached it; later runs replay a prefix (ChoiceStream with_replay + Continuation) to return to a frontier cell and explore from there, instead of restarting from the title screen. Requires a settle step so replays reach the same world (deterministic RNG done in phase 0; also time, asset loading order).

title: Settle step: make replay of a choice prefix reach the same world
description: Before archiving, verify that replaying the prefix reproduces the cell (state digest equality). Sources of divergence: wall-clock time, async asset loading, multi-threaded RNG stream, audio. Settle = wait until loading states finish / digest stable before taking the next action.
acceptance_criteria: Replaying an archived prefix reaches the same state digest in >= 95% of cases on the fixtures.

title: Per-action attribution: which systems/observers ran after an input
description: Correlate each input (key, combo, click, drag) with systems and observers that ran in the next frames (schedule trace / system run counts) -> coverage tiers per widget/key: 'did something', 'did nothing observable', 'not tried'. Feeds keys_found/combos_found with stronger evidence than 'followed by novelty'.
acceptance_criteria: Report shows per-input effect tier; known_answer K1 (zero false 'has an effect' claims) measurable.

title: Honesty section: input kinds and areas NOT exercised
description: Report explicitly: input kinds not tried (gamepad, text, wheel, touch...), chords only by chance, global-observer click areas probed only at random, states never entered, widgets never clicked/dragged, run ended while still discovering. 'No findings' must be scoped to what was reached.
acceptance_criteria: Every report has the section; README documents it.

title: Leafwing action driving
description: Instead of raw keys only, drive declared LW actions directly by their bindings (one per action per screen, least-tried), so actions bound to rare keys / mouse / gamepad get tried. Report actions never fired (lw.rs DeclaredButDead already flags dead bindings).
acceptance_criteria: thetawave: every declared MenuAction/PlayerAction tried at least once per run.

title: Gamepad input
description: Synthesize a gamepad (bevy_input gamepad entity + GamepadButton/axis events) in the takeover; explore buttons/sticks like keys (least-tried per screen, holds, stick sweeps). Leafwing gamepad bindings from the LW reader feed the declared surface.
acceptance_criteria: A gamepad-only test game is driven to a new state; report lists gamepad inputs tried.

title: Modifier + click / drag (shift-click, ctrl-drag)
description: Reuse the combo mechanism for the mouse: occasionally hold Ctrl/Shift through a click or drag. Must coordinate the keyboard and mouse systems (both hold state resources) deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: Test game reacting only to shift-click is found; summary reports it.

title: Mouse wheel / scroll
description: Emit MouseWheel (raw + wrapped WindowEvent) over widgets and random spots, a few notches each; PointerScroll observers and ScrollArea widgets react. Count in the summary.
acceptance_criteria: Test with a ScrollArea or PointerScroll observer reacts; summary counts scrolls.

title: Chords of two ordinary keys from Leafwing declarations
description: src/discovery/lw.rs fans a ButtonlikeChord out to one row per member with chord=true but no grouping id. Add a chord group id to LwDeclaration, carry declared chords into the explorer, and press all members together (like combos) at least once per screen. Covers A+D style chords that modifier combos miss; known_answer K4 (ShiftLeft+KeyL) is already covered by modifier combos.
acceptance_criteria: A test game bound to a 2-key LW chord enters its state; summary lists the chord under combos_found.

title: Explorer: G5 / T3 style targets need the explorer's own report (unmeasurable today)
description: Targets like 'report Quit as a terminal action, never a crash' (game_menu G5), 'Victory reported as never reached' (thetawave T3), known_answer K1-K4 are marked unmeasurable. Teach src/evaluation.rs to read report.exploration (states_entered, keys_found, combos_found, widgets_never_clicked) and the known_answer ground truth.
acceptance_criteria: evaluate reports hits for G5, T3, K1-K4.

title: Mines: M1 (start a game) slower with the explorer than baseline
description: Quick eval on 719d19d: M1 median frame 1083 vs baseline 489. Likely the menu's 3 difficulty buttons compete with back-outs/prior keys, or clicks land on non-button text. Investigate with the full eval's traces.

title: CI speed-up (42 min -> ~7.5 min)
description: Parallel jobs (lint / test-build / test x3 nextest partitions / fixtures / ci aggregator), Swatinem/rust-cache saved on main only, nextest archive+partition, toolchain pinned by uninstalling others (rust-cache hashes all toolchains), cargo-nextest@0.9.152. Branch protection: 'ci' check required, strict=false. Bazel rejected (PR #106 closed).

title: Use new coverage edges as explorer novelty
description: Credit inputs followed by new edges (like keys_found), prefer screens/actions that keep producing edges; archive cells by coverage in phase 3.
acceptance_criteria: Measured gain on the full eval.

title: Fixture bugs found by exploration: keep a list
description: Real findings so far: thetawave fork missing assets/sounds/menu_input_success.wav (fixture-port bug, fixed in #112). Add new ones here as children.

title: Phase 4: coverage-guided exploration (sancov)
description: Dev-only build of the game with -C instrument-coverage or -C passes=sancov-module (-Cllvm-args=-sanitizer-coverage-level=3, trace-pc-guard) so the bot sees new code edges as novelty (like a fuzzer), not only new states/screens. Acceptable because released binaries never include bevy_playtest.

title: Spike: sancov edge counters from a game binary under the takeover
description: Prototype: build a fixture with sanitizer coverage, expose the edge-counter map via the takeover (shared memory or in-process since the harness is in-process), measure overhead and signal quality on game_menu/mines.
acceptance_criteria: Decision note: overhead, setup cost for users, expected gain.

title: Text input widgets
description: When a TextInput (bevy_ui_widgets) or focused text field is on screen, type short strings (letters, digits, empty, very long, unicode) and Enter. Report text fields seen/filled.
acceptance_criteria: Test game with a name field that unlocks a state on Enter is passed.

title: CI: balance nextest partitions
description: test (1..3) partitions are uneven; balance by duration (nextest partition hash vs count, or split heavy fixture tests). Deferred by maintainer in favour of exploration work.
acceptance_criteria: Slowest partition within ~20% of the fastest; total CI wall time does not grow.
